title: The Purified Ones And Verifying Scholars Proof Through Demonstrations

questions.question: Where did the traveller go after leaving the gathering of the prophets?
questions.answer: He went to a place of learning with truthful and carefully thinking scholars.

questions.question: What kind of people were in that classroom?
questions.answer: They were pure, honest scholars who supported the prophets’ message with strong proofs.

questions.question: What important faith truths were they proving?
questions.answer: They were proving matters of belief, especially that Allah exists and that He is One.

questions.question: About how many learned people did the traveller see there?
questions.answer: He saw thousands of brilliant minds and hundreds of thousands of careful, honored scholars.

questions.question: What made their proofs so strong?
questions.answer: Their proofs were deep, clear, and certain, so they left no room for doubt.

questions.question: Why is their agreement important even though they were different from each other?
questions.answer: Because people with different abilities and viewpoints still reached the same belief, which shows the truth is strong.

questions.question: What does the passage say a denier would be showing by fighting against all those scholars?
questions.answer: He would be showing serious ignorance and stubbornness.

questions.question: What lesson is taught by the example of someone shutting his eyes in daylight?
questions.answer: Refusing to see the truth does not change the truth; it only harms the person who refuses.

questions.question: For how long had the scholars’ light been spreading widely?
questions.answer: It had been shining over much of the world for more than a thousand years.

questions.question: What could the people of denial not do to the strength found in that classroom?
questions.answer: They could not shake it or destroy it.

questions.question: What is the main message of the short summary at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The united agreement of purified scholars is a powerful proof of Allah’s necessary existence and oneness.

questions.question: Who invited the traveller into the classroom in this passage?
questions.answer: Scholars who confirm the prophets’ message with very strong evidence invited him.

questions.question: How are these scholars described in character?
questions.answer: They are described as pure, truthful, deep-thinking, and careful.

questions.question: What was the traveller able to see when he entered their classroom?
questions.answer: He saw a huge number of gifted and highly learned people explaining faith with strong proofs.

questions.question: Which belief comes first among the truths they were proving?
questions.answer: The first one mentioned is the necessary existence of Allah and His unity.

questions.question: What does it show when many intelligent scholars agree on the basics of faith?
questions.answer: It shows that their conclusion is very reliable and hard to deny.

questions.question: Did the passage say all the scholars were exactly alike in thinking and ability?
questions.answer: No. They differed in ability and viewpoint, but still agreed on the main parts of belief.

questions.question: Why does each scholar’s use of a certain proof matter?
questions.answer: It matters because each one is relying on solid and sure evidence, not guesses.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the real effect of denying such clear truth?
questions.answer: It does not darken the truth itself; it only leaves the denier in his own darkness.

questions.question: What picture does the passage use to explain this idea?
questions.answer: It gives the picture of a person closing his own eyes and then only making things dark for himself.

questions.question: What did the traveller learn about the influence of these scholars over time?
questions.answer: Their light had been enlightening a large part of the earth for over a thousand years.

questions.question: What kind of strength did the traveller find in that classroom?
questions.answer: He found spiritual and moral strength that disbelief could not overpower.

questions.question: In one sentence, what did the traveller learn there?
questions.answer: He learned that the united, certain proofs of purified scholars strongly testify to Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What new group does the traveller meet in this part of the journey?
questions.answer: He meets purified and truthful scholars who defend the message of the prophets.

questions.question: What do these scholars do for the prophets’ message?
questions.answer: They support it by giving powerful and decisive evidence.

questions.question: What does the classroom show about the study of faith?
questions.answer: It shows that faith is taught with careful thinking, knowledge, and proof.

questions.question: What two main beliefs are specially mentioned as being proven?
questions.answer: Allah’s existence and Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Why is the scholars’ unity meaningful?
questions.answer: It is meaningful because so many wise people agreed on the same foundations of faith.

questions.question: What makes their agreement even more impressive?
questions.answer: They still agreed even though they did not all have the same level of ability or the same way of looking at things.

questions.question: What would someone have to ignore in order to reject all these scholars?
questions.answer: He would have to ignore the strong evidence and act stubbornly.

questions.question: How does the passage describe such denial in a simple image?
questions.answer: It is like a person shutting his own eyes and pretending the day is dark.

questions.question: What does that image teach about truth?
questions.answer: Truth stays true even when someone refuses to accept it.

questions.question: What long-term result of the scholars’ work did the traveller notice?
questions.answer: He noticed that their light had guided much of the world for more than a thousand years.

questions.question: What could not defeat the strength of their teaching?
questions.answer: Even all the strength of those who reject faith could not tear it down.

questions.question: What final belief statement is highlighted in this section?
questions.answer: That all these purified scholars agree, with clear and certain proofs, that Allah alone is the One true God.

questions.question: Why are the scholars in this passage important to the traveller’s journey?
questions.answer: They help him go deeper in faith by showing strong evidence for what the prophets taught.

questions.question: What special qualities are given for these scholars?
questions.answer: They are deep, original, exact, pure, and very truthful.

questions.question: What did the traveller see as soon as he entered their place of learning?
questions.answer: He saw many highly intelligent and honored scholars proving the truths of faith.

questions.question: Were they proving only one small idea, or many faith matters?
questions.answer: They were proving many faith matters, with Allah’s existence and unity at the center.

questions.question: Why does the passage point out their differences in outlook?
questions.answer: It points this out to show that their agreement is even stronger because they were not all the same.

questions.question: What is one reason their shared conclusion carries weight?
questions.answer: Each scholar was depending on evidence that was firm and certain.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about a person who still denies their conclusion?
questions.answer: It suggests that such a person is being extremely ignorant and stubborn.

questions.question: What kind of matters are described as not open to simple denial and approval by stubborn talk?
questions.answer: They are negative claims that cannot be settled just by empty refusing.

questions.question: How does the example of closed eyes help explain disbelief?
questions.answer: It shows that refusing to look does not erase what is already clear.

questions.question: What did the traveller understand about the reach of these scholars’ light?
questions.answer: He understood that it had illuminated half the world for over a thousand years.

questions.question: What kind of power did he find in their classroom?
questions.answer: He found a moral and spiritual power too strong to be broken by deniers.

questions.question: What does the final summary say their agreement points to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s necessary existence and His oneness.

questions.question: In this passage, how is the classroom different from an ordinary classroom?
questions.answer: It is a place where faith is taught through wisdom, proof, and spiritual light.

questions.question: Who are the teachers in that classroom?
questions.answer: They are purified, very truthful scholars who confirm the prophets’ teachings.

questions.question: What did the scholars prove so clearly that doubt was pushed away?
questions.answer: They proved the truths of faith, especially that Allah exists and is One.

questions.question: Why is the number of scholars mentioned?
questions.answer: It helps show how great and wide this shared witness to the truth is.

questions.question: What is powerful about their agreement?
questions.answer: So many smart and clear-sighted people reached the same result.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about rejecting all of them?
questions.answer: It implies that rejection would come from ignorance and stubborn refusal, not sound thinking.

questions.question: What happens when someone “makes night” by closing his eyes?
questions.answer: He only blocks the light from himself, not from the world.

questions.question: What does that tell us about people who deny clear proofs?
questions.answer: It tells us they harm their own understanding while the truth remains bright.

questions.question: How long had these scholars been giving light to the world?
questions.answer: For more than one thousand years.

questions.question: What could not succeed against the strength in their classroom?
questions.answer: The united force of all deniers could not shake or destroy it.

questions.question: What lesson should a student take from this passage?
questions.answer: A student should learn that true belief is supported by united, careful, and strong evidence.

questions.question: After the prophets’ assembly, what kind of place did the traveller enter?
questions.answer: He entered the learning circle of purified scholars.

questions.question: What was the relationship between those scholars and the prophets?
questions.answer: The scholars supported and confirmed the prophets’ claims with proof.

questions.question: What words show that these scholars were serious and trustworthy?
questions.answer: They are shown as pure, truthful, careful, and highly respected.

questions.question: What did the traveller notice about the way they explained belief?
questions.answer: They explained it with deep and powerful demonstrations.

questions.question: Which beliefs are named as the leaders of all the faith matters they proved?
questions.answer: Allah’s necessary existence and His unity.

questions.question: Why does shared agreement among many different scholars matter so much?
questions.answer: Because it is hard to think that so many wise people would all reach the same result without truth behind it.

questions.question: What kind of proof did each scholar use?
questions.answer: Each one used a proof that was strong and certain.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does denial of this united witness really show?
questions.answer: It shows deep ignorance and stubbornness.

questions.question: What simple life example is used to explain a denier’s condition?
questions.answer: A person shutting his own eyes and thinking he has turned daytime into nighttime.

questions.question: What part of the world had been lit by these scholars?
questions.answer: Half of the globe had been lit by their light.

questions.question: For what length of time had that light continued?
questions.answer: It had continued for more than a thousand years.

questions.question: What is the main point of the ending statement in this passage?
questions.answer: The united proofs of purified scholars testify clearly that Allah necessarily exists and is One.
